steps.what: Show the stored service plan for bus and food services.
Plan, coordinate, and oversee school logistics programs such as bus and food services.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the service plan already held for bus and food services. The education administrator plans, coordinates, and oversees those school logistics programs. A route solver that already runs is not this labour. The plan does not roster staff from behaviour. A service with no plan stays with the administrator.
tasks.previous_blocker: A bus service was treated as overseen because a route plan existed, and the administrator had not coordinated it.
tasks.enabler_now: A service plan already held can be opened. Planning and oversight still have to be done by the administrator.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the bus or food service should change is still the administrator's oversight.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator plans and oversees the service. The plan is only what is already held.
tasks.altitude: Oversight stays with the administrator. A route solver that already runs is not this labour.

reach.task: Run a service this administrator oversees.
reach.learn: A stored plan is not oversight.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored service plan is a lookup. It does not plan or oversee the bus or food service.
A route solver that already runs is existing runtime. Staff are not rostered from behaviour by this screen.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An education administrator in a mid-size European school group. A stored record is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: The service id and the plan already stored. The screen does not roster staff and does not mark the service as overseen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the education administrator finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the plan before the administrator oversees the service. Do not credit a solver that already runs.
unknowns: Whether bus plans and food plans share one file.
research_questions: Who oversees a bus or food service on a day the administrator is absent?

already_counted.description: Planning and overseeing the logistics programs stays with the administrator.

incremental.description: Drop a service plan that has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The administrator still plans, coordinates, and oversees school logistics programs such as bus and food services. Only opening a service plan that was already held is removed. A route solver that already runs is not this labour, and staff are not rostered from behaviour.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop programs that follow government codes.

steps.what: Show the stored government codes for this facility.
Review and interpret those codes and develop programs to ensure adherence.
File the accepted program for facility safety, security, and maintenance.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the government code already held. The education administrator reviews and interprets the code and develops the program for adherence, facility safety, security, and maintenance. The screen does not make a safety decision. The store files only the accepted program. A code with no record stays with the administrator.
tasks.previous_blocker: A facility was treated as safe because a code title was on file, and the administrator had not interpreted it.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored code can be opened. The administrator still interprets it and develops the program.
tasks.still_hard: What adherence requires for this facility is still the administrator's reading of the code.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator interprets the code and develops the program. The screen only shows the code already held.
tasks.altitude: Interpretation stays with the administrator. Filing stores only the program the administrator accepted.

reach.task: Follow a program this administrator has accepted.
reach.learn: A code title is not a safety decision.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored government code is a lookup. It does not interpret the code or decide that a facility is safe.
A safety, security, or maintenance decision is not made by a screen. The administrator develops the program and accepts it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An education administrator in a mid-size European school group. A stored record is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: The code id and the code text already stored. The screen does not decide that a facility is safe. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the education administrator finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the code text before the administrator interprets it. File only the accepted program.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the education administrator.
Reading a stored code is not a safety decision. The administrator interprets the code.
unknowns: Whether safety, security, and maintenance codes share one file.
research_questions: Who accepts a program before it is treated as the way this facility follows a code?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the code and developing the program stays with the administrator.

incremental.description: Withdraw a program whose code text was replaced.

approvals.approved_version: code adherence program accepted by the education administrator

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The administrator still reviews and interprets government codes and develops programs for adherence, facility safety, security, and maintenance. Only opening the stored code and filing the accepted program is removed. The screen does not make a safety decision.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show identified educational needs and other organizations already named.
Develop partnerships with businesses and communities to provide school programs.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the identified educational needs already held. The education administrator develops partnerships with businesses, communities, and other organizations to provide school programs. The record does not form the partnership. The partnership is the conversation, not the stored need. A need with no record stays with the administrator.
tasks.previous_blocker: A partnership was treated as formed because an educational need was on file, and no organization had been met.
tasks.enabler_now: A need already recorded can be opened. The partnership still has to be developed in conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Whether an organization will help is still agreed in the conversation, not by the stored need.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator develops the partnership. The record only shows a need already identified.
tasks.altitude: The partnership stays with the administrator. The stored need is only visible.

reach.task: Discuss a partnership this administrator develops.
reach.learn: A stored need is not a partnership.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored educational need is a lookup. It does not develop a partnership.
A partnership with a business or a community organization is a conversation. The record does not form it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An education administrator in a mid-size European school group. A stored record is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.
Fields: The need id and the need already stored. The screen does not mark a partnership as formed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the education administrator finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the need before the conversation. Do not treat the record as the partnership.
unknowns: Whether businesses, communities, and other organizations share one contact list.
research_questions: What must be agreed before a partnership is called developed?

already_counted.description: Developing the partnership stays with the administrator.

incremental.description: Drop a need whose record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The administrator still develops partnerships with businesses, communities, and other organizations to meet educational needs and provide school programs. Only opening a need that was already recorded is removed. The record saves none of that partnership.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct school maintenance and facility use.

steps.what: Show school facility use already booked.
Direct and coordinate school maintenance services and facilities.

tasks.design: The {CALENDAR} store shows school facility use already booked. The education administrator directs and coordinates maintenance services and the use of those facilities. A booking solver that already runs is not this labour. The listing does not direct the work. A facility with no booking stays with the administrator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Maintenance was treated as directed because a facility booking existed, and the administrator had not directed the work.
tasks.enabler_now: A booking already made can be opened. Directing maintenance and facility use still has to be done by the administrator.
tasks.still_hard: What maintenance should happen, and who may use the facility, is still the administrator's direction.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator directs the work. The booking only shows a use already recorded.
tasks.altitude: Direction stays with the administrator. A booking solver that already runs is not this labour.

reach.task: Carry out work this administrator directs.
reach.learn: A booking is not a direction to maintain a facility.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored facility booking is a lookup. It does not direct maintenance or facility use.
A booking solver that already runs is existing runtime. It is not labour saved from this administrator.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An education administrator in a mid-size European school group. A stored record is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: The booking id and the use already stored. The screen does not direct the maintenance and does not change the booking. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the education administrator finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the booking before the administrator directs the work. Do not credit a solver that already runs.
unknowns: Whether maintenance jobs and facility bookings share one calendar.
research_questions: Who directs maintenance when the booked use and the needed repair conflict?

already_counted.description: Directing maintenance and facility use stays with the administrator.

incremental.description: Drop a booking that has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The administrator still directs and coordinates school maintenance services and the use of school facilities. Only opening a booking that was already made is removed. A booking solver that already runs is not this labour.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Transport and catering leads receive direction from this administrator. A service plan is not that direction.
Partners hear the educational need from this administrator, not from a stored note.
skills_to_grow: Oversee logistics in person. A route solver that already runs is not this labour.
Interpret a government code and develop the program. The screen does not decide safety.
